subject: cudaMemcpyToSymbol: SetSim copy to cSim failed invalid device symbol

messages.author: venkat
messages.body:
Hello Everyone,
I tried run amber(16,Tools-17) with newly installed cuda(9.0) in single GPU
(Tesla C2050) based on prerequisite AMBER 16 GPU ACCELERATION SUPPORT
<
https://ambermd.org/gpus16/index.htm
>
While perform got error : *cudaMemcpyToSymbol: SetSim copy to cSim failed
invalid device symbol*.
So, please provide a possible solution to this error, and kindly get text
file for the necessary machine & driver info from drive link
<
https://drive.google.com/file/d/11_8XR3DX75SEuABibUSr53R5h2xW3DXa/view?usp=sharing
>
Thank you
Sincerely
venkat

messages.author: David Cerutti
messages.body:
I believe that Amber16 does not support CUDA9. There are newer CUDA
compilers, but much newer Amber versions that 16/17. You will need to
switch back to CUDA <= 8, or upgrade your Amber installation.
